title: Tools
description: Handy utilities — heavy processing runs where it fits best.

hub.video_desc: Turn a storyboard of images, clips and colors into an MP4 with captions, Ken Burns motion and background music.
hub.watermark_desc: Remove the visible Gemini watermark from AI-generated images. 100% client-side — files never leave your browser.

video.title: Video Render
video.description: Compose a storyboard and render it to MP4 via the server-side ffmpeg pipeline.
video.source_hint: Workspace path (e.g. images/scene1.png) or https:// URL
video.caption: Caption
video.cancel_confirm_desc: The job will stop and its partial output discarded.
video.empty_jobs: No render jobs yet. Compose a storyboard and hit Render.
video.not_enabled: Video rendering is not enabled on this server.
video.worker_note: Jobs are processed by the video worker; progress updates automatically.
video.limit_hint: Up to 60 scenes, 1–30s each, 10 min total.

watermark.title: Gemini Watermark Remover
watermark.description: Removes the visible Gemini watermark from AI-generated images using reverse alpha blending. Everything runs in your browser — images are never uploaded.
watermark.privacy: 100% local — nothing is uploaded. Only the visible watermark is targeted (not invisible marks like SynthID).
watermark.drop_hint: or click to browse — PNG/JPEG/WebP, batch supported
watermark.credits: Algorithm: gemini-watermark-remover (MIT) by GargantuaX, based on AllenK's reverse alpha blending method.
watermark.usage_note: Use only on images you have the rights to modify. You are responsible for complying with applicable terms of service.
